item.text: The disposition records distinguish decisions about a whole document from decisions about part of it. I’m filtering for `source_verified` and `whole_target`, then joining each decision to its meeting. I’m using exact document numbers for pack membership; three named CRs have no pack link in the records inspected so far.

item.text: The joins produced an ambiguity for RP-253013: ten member CRs have both `agreed` and `endorsed` as source-verified whole-document dispositions at RAN1#122b. I’m including both and noting that an alternative reading would select only a final disposition. The three CRs with no recorded pack membership will have empty row lists and explanatory notes.

import json
with open('questions.jsonl') as f: questions=[json.loads(line) for line in f]
with open('answers.jsonl') as f: answers=[json.loads(line) for line in f]
assert len(questions)==len(answers)==23
assert [q['id'] for q in questions]==[a['id'] for a in answers]
for q,a in zip(questions,answers):
 assert set(a)=={'id','rows','note'}
 assert isinstance(a['note'],str)
 assert len(a['rows'])==len({tuple(row) for row in a['rows']})
 for row in a['rows']:
  assert len(row)==len(q['fields'])
  assert all(isinstance(value,str) for value in row)
print('Validated JSONL structure, question order, field counts, string values, and deduplication.')
print('Questions:',len(answers),'Rows:',sum(len(a['rows']) for a in answers),'Empty answers:',sum(not a['rows'] for a in answers),'Nonempty notes:',sum(bool(a['note']) for a in answers))
for a in answers: print(a['id'],len(a['rows']))
PY"

I interpreted each JSON-LD `@graph` as linked records joined through identifiers. Qualifying dispositions require `evidenceStatus: source_verified` and assessment scope `whole_target`; their decision events supply the RAN1 meeting. Pack membership supplies the pack number and plenary meeting, while section links supply specification, release, and clause. I matched exact document numbers, copied meeting names as recorded, checked release filters against document metadata, and deduplicated identical answer rows.
